description: CodeScope-local specification for selecting and supplying Eliware Convention v8 records to reviews.

authoritativeFor: CodeScope convention-evidence selection and review-input boundaries.
notAuthoritativeFor: Repository requirements, convention wording, exemptions, operational procedures, publication, deployment, or project behavior.

crosslinks.authoritativeFor: Universal repository conventions and profile authority.

reviewContract.applicability: Read only the repository types declared by package.json eliware.conventions.apply.
reviewContract.authority: Treat the linked Conventions records as the sole authority for repository requirements and directive text.
reviewContract.missingEvidence: If the canonical Conventions checkout or an applicable record is unavailable, report convention alignment as unverified; do not infer or import requirements.
reviewContract.scope: Supply the selected canonical records as review evidence. Do not redefine, duplicate, or extend their requirements.
